graph.title: Threads of Memory
graph.edgeBreakdown: USES {uses} · ABOUT {about} · LEARNED {learned} · DEVELOPED {developed} · RELATED_TO {related} · SOLVED {solved} · DEPENDS_ON {dependsOn}

chat.title: AI Librarian
chat.pending: The librarian is scanning the shelves…
chat.placeholder: Which book deals with realtime features?
chat.intro: What are you looking for? Ask by technology, concept, or project name and I will find it on the shelves.
chat.privacy: Questions and answers are handled only by the local LLM on this machine. Nothing leaves it.
chat.glowNotice: {count} books are glowing on the shelves.
chat.emptyQuestion: Please write what you are looking for.
chat.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
chat.noGraph: No threads of memory yet. Weave the graph first.
chat.noMatch: Nothing was found under that name. Try a technology, project, or concept (e.g. react, realtime).
chat.degraded: The local LLM (Ollama) could not be reached, so here are the raw findings without a summary. Run `ollama serve` and the librarian will answer in prose.

settings.title: Choose the librarian's voice
settings.subtitle: Pick the local model used for librarian answers and graph extraction. This choice takes precedence over OLLAMA_MODEL in .env.local.
settings.offline: Could not reach the local LLM (Ollama). Please check that it is running.
settings.offlineHelp: The local LLM is not running. Light the lantern with the command below, then check again.
settings.installedEmpty: No models installed yet. Download one of the recommended models below.
settings.saved: {model} will answer from now on. It applies to the next question and the next graph build.
settings.invalidModel: That model name is not valid.
settings.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
settings.pulling: Downloading the model — this takes several minutes
settings.pullFailed: Could not download {model}. Check your disk space and network.
settings.applyNote: Changing the model leaves the existing graph untouched. Rebuild the graph to re-weave it with the new model.
settings.privacy: This only selects a local model on this machine. No external API is called.
